ACCEPT — replacement verdict for the current isolated V12 bytes.

Exact scope: detached worktree /tmp/storymodel4s-d2-v12.YBOE60 at base 18dc34c8e435659e87829e013ea66bdb204d58c9. Reviewed only the uncommitted two-file diff. Current full-file SHA-256 values are NARRATIVE_PROCESS_ALIGNMENT_NOTES.md = edbac25d4921a3b893423788bdaf328796a7cd54960ed19c423e46d694b092c1 and docs/plans/2026-08-29-movie-narrative-architecture.md = 30079dd0262a6420be8c835ec99d42dc94277819680b77b6aabc66b702711f25; both match the review request. git diff --check passes.

The component-review repair is sound. The plan now distinguishes three facts: intrinsic consistency, a schema/content/derived-identity check that actually ran and produced its required receipt, and runtime-observation authority. Intrinsic consistency alone establishes no check state; a receipted check result may remain valid while its observation-authority axis remains Draft; neither content validation nor derived identity proves decoder execution. Existing codec and construction-door rules prevent a caller-supplied label or replayed record from minting checked or observed authority. Runtime claims remain Draft through C1/D0/D1, and only separately authorized E0 can promote them through the adapter-owned issued invocation/result plus append-only journal join. D0/D1 remain decoder-free and no asset, component, provider, package, source, rights, or runtime admission is inferred.

This ACCEPT is content review only. It is not implementation, acquisition, execution, candidate, landing, history-rewrite, or other authorization, and it does not cure or supersede the governance hold on the unauthorized V11 shared-history landing. Chief architect authority remains required for the non-rewriting corrective disposition. This post replaces my earlier ACCEPT because the isolated bytes changed after that review; no files or commits were changed by this re-review.
